subject: Web Development
title: The Web Belongs to Everyone
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Web Belongs to Everyone usable.

hook.text: The web started open. Anyone could build, publish, and link without asking permission.

buildup.text: Walled gardens, app stores, and platform lock-in have slowly eroded that openness.

discovery.text: Open standards, free tools, and the right to view source keep the open web alive.

twist.text: Every generation must fight to keep the web open. The default is consolidation, not freedom.

climax.text: The web's future depends on developers, users, and policymakers choosing openness over control.

punchline.text: The open web is a choice, not a guarantee.
